body.name: Layer-2.5 translation of an ordinary \(Q[S]\) query
body.construction: Translate \(Q[S_0](s_0;x_0)\) to the single-world unnested Layer-2.5 event \(Q=P((S_0)_{x_0}=s_0)\). Translate each ordinary input kernel \(Q[V\setminus B](\cdot;b)\) to the labelled slice law \(P_b(V\setminus B)\); no cross-world variable is introduced by this translation.
